model_dataset.title: Custom model (optional)
model_dataset.description: Leave blank to use 'Model family' below. To run a self-trained model not published through astril's model manifest, upload its directory (its pipeline.json plus checkpoints) as a 'Files' dataset and select it here -- it then takes precedence over 'Model family'.

model_family.title: Model family
model_family.description: A model family registered in astril's models.json. Ignored if a custom model is selected above. This dropdown is a static list, not a live registry lookup -- add a new family here by hand when one is added to astril's models.json.

skip_quantify.title: Skip automatic quantify
skip_quantify.description: Stage 3b (quantify) normally runs automatically right after segmentation. Enable this to stop after segmentation alone -- e.g. to manually correct masks before quantifying -- then run the separate 'astril: Quantify segmentation volumes' process afterward.

labels_json_dataset.title: Labels contract (optional, for automatic quantify)
labels_json_dataset.description: Rarely needed: the model's own pipeline.json labels normally carry through to Stage 3b automatically via segmentation_provenance.json. To override, Upload a labels.json ({"labels": {"1": "...", ...}}) as a 'Files' dataset (exactly one .json) and select it here.
